pipelines.old: v1 POST /api/style-me: photo check (vision) + design (1 outfit) + image edit at quality auto + face check (vision)
pipelines.new: v2 POST /api/v2/sessions: local perception + design (3 outfits) + image edit at quality low (2 streamed previews) + local identity check

assumptions.tokenizer: o200k_base (gpt-tokenizer), exact for prompt, schema and response text
assumptions.visionImageTokens: gpt-5.2 tile formula: 85 + 170 per 512 px tile after fitting 2048 and scaling the short side to 768
assumptions.imageEditTokens: calibrated on this project's real gpt-image-1.5 calls: {"low":1100,"medium":2750,"high":6000} total per call; +100 output tokens per streamed preview
assumptions.oldImageQualityAuto: resolved as medium in the headline numbers (conservative); high shown separately (matches the real $0.26/visitor of 5 Nov)
assumptions.reasoningTokens: 0 for both (unknown offline; the old pipeline makes 3 text calls to the new one's 1, so this favours the old)
assumptions.faceCheckRetries: none needed (face check passes); a real drift would add a second image and check to the old pipeline only

recordedReference.note: Real measurements already in this project, for comparison with the modelled numbers above
recordedReference.newPipelineReadme: 1,857–1,970 tokens and about $0.028 per look (real calls, 6 Nov 2026)
recordedReference.report5Nov: about $0.26 per visitor (one text call plus one image, default quality)
